title: A Crowdsourced Study of ChatBot Influence in Value-Driven Decision Making Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: A crowdsourced experiment measuring changes in users' policy preferences (US defense spending) on an 8-point Likert scale before and after interacting with ChatBots prompted to exhibit specific value-framing (e.g., fiscal conservatism or pacifism), supplemented by qualitative thematic analysis of the chat transcripts to observe persuasion and backfire effects across different political affiliations.
